root_cause: External source observations, company-specific impact evidence and action candidates were presented in separate portal sections rather than as one actionable customer card.
fix: Join a signal with its scoped company impact and matching existing action in the authenticated Portal V2 UI. Show reason, source, next step and proof maturity; block stale sources and expired deadlines.
prevention_rule: A public signal is not proven buying intent; link to an executable action only when tenant-specific evidence and an existing canonical action reference exist. Do not synthesize sales.
